evidence: Disassembled Go main and browser, wallet, posting and URL routines. The named routines return constants, and main prints those results; the sample contains no corresponding collection or transfer.
Calls DPAPI on a blob and assigns a webhook path; no request, upload or transfer of the decrypted value is present.
The Keychain command is a string value, not an invocation. An independent HTTP request has no credential data. The matcher now distinguishes an actual os.execute call.
Calls SecItemCopyMatching and assigns a POST method, but contains no request execution or connection between the keychain result and a request body.
Searches for wallet and keystore names and separately POSTs an undefined result variable. The code does not bind search output to the sent value.
Checks a GitHub token and removes the home cache after a 401/403 response; it does not wipe the home directory. The conditional cache deletion is detected separately.
